zh.title: 房产持有成本：税、保险、HOA、Mello-Roos 和维修储备
zh.seo_title: 加州房产持有成本清单｜陈靖
zh.description: 把房贷以外的持有成本逐项拆开：房产税和 direct charges、保险、HOA 和特别摊派、Mello-Roos、维修储备，并说明每项去哪里查、税务抵扣上有哪些限制。
zh.lead: 每月实际花在房子上的钱，往往不止贷款月供。这篇把几项持有成本拆开，告诉你每项去哪里查，方便做一张属于自己的年度表。

en.title: Holding Costs: Tax, Insurance, HOA, Mello-Roos and Repair Reserves
en.seo_title: California Home Holding Costs | Jing Chen
en.description: A line-by-line look at ownership costs beyond the mortgage: property tax, insurance, HOA dues, Mello-Roos and repair reserves, and where to find each.
en.lead: What a home really costs each month goes well past the mortgage payment. Here is each item, where to find the number, and how to build your own annual budget.
